# FlowSaaS

> Production-ready n8n workflow templates, an all-access VIP pass, done-for-you
> managed automation setups, and browser-run Micro-SaaS tools — no n8n
> installation required for the tools.

FlowSaaS sells and helps deploy n8n automation workflows across four tiers: a
one-time-purchase template store, an unlimited-downloads VIP subscription,
fully managed done-for-you setups, and on-demand browser tools that run
workflows without touching n8n directly.

## Key pages

- [Workflow Catalog](/workflows) — browse all published n8n workflow templates
- [Managed Services](/services) — done-for-you setup, process, and packages
- [Micro-SaaS Tools](/tools) — run automations from the browser, no n8n needed
- [Pricing](/pricing) — templates, VIP Pass, DFY, and credit pack pricing
- [Integrations](/integrations) — every app FlowSaaS workflows connect
- [ROI Calculator](/roi-calculator) — estimate hours and cost saved

Note: this file is regenerated once the workflow catalog is seeded (Phase 3)
to include the top 12 workflow pages directly, per Section 13.6.
